errors.text_span: Основната цел е да се сравнят тези две мерки на производителност през годините.
errors.evidence: This sentence interprets the purpose of the chart rather than describing its content. It's an inference about why the chart was made.
The units on the Y-axis are explicitly labeled as 'Лева/заето лице' (BGN/employed person), not just 'лева' (BGN). This is an oversimplification.

errors.text_span: а също така има лек спад в 2009 г. (19 510 лева)
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims there is a slight decline ('лек спад') for the blue line in 2009. The chart data shows an increase for the blue line from 19,082 in 2008 to 19,510 in 2009.
The description omits the fact that the blue line is dashed, a visual feature that helps distinguish it from the solid orange line.
